% test-pdfprimitive's \pdfprimitive, \pdf@primitive, and \tex_primitive:D
% in a document that loads hyperref, which loads pdftexcmds in the
% preamble, and leaves \pdfoutput unset. A heading's text goes to the table
% of contents and to hyperref's bookmarks.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\section{Head \pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g}x end}\label{head}

Literal: before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after, a link to section~\ref{head}.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} six end.} after.

\makeatletter
Pdftexcmds: before\pdf@primitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after.
\makeatother

\ExplSyntaxOn
Expl:~before \tex_primitive:D \pdfliteral {0~g} ~ after.
\ExplSyntaxOff

Link: before\pdfprimitive\pdfstartlink goto name{section.1}to the head\pdfprimitive\pdfendlink{} after.
\end{document}
